name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey in motorsport began with a youthful fascination for rallying, fueled by the roaring engines echoing through the hills near his childhood home in the Algarve. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, followed by a decade honing his skills as a race engineer, bouncing between Formula Renault and GT racing. His meticulous approach and talent for optimizing car setups quickly garnered attention. 

Recognized for his ability to bridge the gap between the technical team and the drivers, Ricardo seamlessly transitioned into a sporting director role. He excels at fostering a collaborative environment, believing that open communication is paramount to success. Ricardo's strength lies in his data-driven decision-making and his uncanny ability to predict strategic opportunities during races, combined with his calm demeanor under pressure, making him a respected figure within Porsche Penske Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of average height with a wiry build, always impeccably dressed.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations during races.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of espresso before every race weekend.
